page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated physical cores and 80 vCPUs, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. With a single thread per core configuration, each vCPU maps directly to a physical core, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading overhead. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 9.6 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. The absence of integrated GPUs and local NVMe storage represents a clear tradeoff, positioning this server specifically for memory-bound and compute-intensive workloads that rely on network-attached storage. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated Intel Xeon cores combined with a substantial memory footprint provides a balanced allocation for enterprise applications requiring large memory spaces without the added cost of specialized GPU hardware.

The ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is suited for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, and high-performance computing tasks that benefit from dedicated single-threaded core execution. It is also appropriate for data processing pipelines and enterprise resource planning systems that require significant RAM capacity and consistent CPU performance.
